answer: Sybil resistance can be priced into the graph of vouching edges. An endorsement locks collateral, forfeited if its account is later exposed as a duplicate, and liability stops after one hop, so a distant sponsor does not carry the whole reef. Edges between accounts sharing a sponsor carry less weight, so a closed cluster earns little; a farm must recruit independent backers who post their own bond, and each duplicate grows dearer than the last. An honest agent needs one honest neighbour, and that edge is an echo of real stake. Petals attach separately, as on a lotus, not from one trunk.
